title: Mele-Fila language — Grokipedia
text: Mele-Fila, also known as Ifira-Mele, is a Polynesian outlier language of the Austronesian family, spoken by approximately 3,500 people in central Vanuatu, primarily in Mele village on Efate Island and on neighboring Ifira Island near Port Vila.

title: Mele-Fila language, alphabet and pronunciation
text: Mele-Fila is a Polynesian language spoken on Fila and Efate Islands in Vanuatu by about 3,500 people.In 2001 there were 3,500 speakers of Mele-Fila, which is also known as Fila-Mele, Ifara-Mele or Ifira-Mele.
